CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.compute_feature_grid(p_instrument_id uuid, p_session_date date, p_assumed_publication_seconds integer DEFAULT 1)
 RETURNS TABLE(session_date date, provider text, instrument_id uuid, provider_symbol text, source_feed text, provider_interval_start timestamp with time zone, provider_interval_end timestamp with time zone, availability_assumed_ts timestamp with time zone, minute_index integer, minutes_from_open integer, minutes_to_close integer, open double precision, high double precision, low double precision, close double precision, volume double precision, trade_count bigint, provider_vwap double precision, bar_present boolean, bar_valid boolean, dollar_volume_close double precision, dollar_volume_vwap double precision, return_1m double precision, return_5m double precision, return_10m double precision, return_20m double precision, return_60m double precision, return_120m double precision, realized_vol_5m double precision, realized_vol_20m double precision, realized_vol_60m double precision, candle_range_pct double precision, candle_body_pct double precision, upper_wick_pct double precision, lower_wick_pct double precision, range_20m_pct double precision, volume_mean_20m double precision, volume_rel_20m double precision, volume_z_20m double precision, dollar_volume_mean_20m double precision, sma_close_5m double precision, sma_close_20m double precision, sma_close_60m double precision, session_vwap_proxy double precision, close_vs_provider_vwap_bps double precision, close_vs_session_vwap_bps double precision, close_vs_sma20_bps double precision, sma5_vs_sma20_bps double precision, missing_bars_20m integer, coverage_20m double precision, microstructure_available boolean, micro_trade_count bigint, micro_quote_count bigint, micro_avg_spread_bps double precision, micro_last_spread_bps double precision, micro_trade_imbalance double precision, micro_quote_size_imbalance double precision, microprice_dislocation_bps double precision, quality_flags jsonb)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE PARALLEL RESTRICTED
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
 SET "TimeZone" TO 'UTC'
AS $function$
with cal as (
 select c.session_date,c.regular_open,c.regular_close
 from market_governance.us_equity_fixed_session_calendar c where c.session_date=p_session_date
), grid as (
 select cal.session_date,cal.regular_open,cal.regular_close,g as interval_start,
        row_number() over(order by g)::integer-1 as minute_index
 from cal cross join lateral
 generate_series(cal.regular_open,cal.regular_close-interval '1 minute',interval '1 minute') g
), id as (
 select c.provider_symbol,c.mapping_quality
 from research_hub.ai_instrument_catalog c
 where c.provider='alpaca' and c.asset_class='us_equity' and c.instrument_id=p_instrument_id
 order by c.effective_from desc nulls last limit 1
), raw as (
 select g.*,b.source_feed,
  b.open as source_open,b.high as source_high,b.low as source_low,b.close as source_close,
  b.volume as source_volume,b.trade_count as source_trade_count,b.vwap as source_vwap,
  m.trade_count as micro_trades,m.quote_count as micro_quotes,m.avg_spread_bps as micro_spread,
  m.last_bid_price,m.last_ask_price,m.last_bid_size,m.last_ask_size,m.last_trade_price,
  m.buy_volume,m.sell_volume,
  (b.instrument_id is not null) as bar_present,(m.instrument_id is not null) as micro_present
 from grid g
 left join public.market_bars_1m_alpaca b
  on b.provider='alpaca' and b.instrument_id=p_instrument_id and b.ts=g.interval_start
 left join public.equity_microstructure_1m m
  on m.provider='alpaca' and m.instrument_id=p_instrument_id and m.ts=g.interval_start
), base as (
 select r.*,
  case when r.source_open>0 and r.source_high>0 and r.source_low>0 and r.source_close>0
   and astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.is_finite_float8(r.source_open)
   and astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.is_finite_float8(r.source_high)
   and astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.is_finite_float8(r.source_low)
   and astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.is_finite_float8(r.source_close)
   and r.source_high>=greatest(r.source_open,r.source_close,r.source_low)
   and r.source_low<=least(r.source_open,r.source_close,r.source_high)
   then true else false end as valid_bar,
  case when r.source_close>0
   and astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.is_finite_float8(r.source_close)
   then r.source_close end as valid_close,
  case when r.source_volume>=0
   and astra_shared_equity_features_20260928_v1.is_finite_float8(r.source_volume)
   then r.source_volume end as valid_volume
 from raw r
), lagged as (
 select b.*,
  lag(b.valid_close,1) over w as close_lag1,
  lag(b.valid_close,5) over w as close_lag5,
  lag(b.valid_close,10) over w as close_lag10,
  lag(b.valid_close,20) over w as close_lag20,
  lag(b.valid_close,60) over w as close_lag60,
  lag(b.valid_close,120) over w as close_lag120,
  count(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 1 preceding and current row) as close_n2,
  count(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 5 preceding and current row) as close_n6,
  count(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 10 preceding and current row) as close_n11,
  count(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 20 preceding and current row) as close_n21,
  count(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 60 preceding and current row) as close_n61,
  count(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 120 preceding and current row) as close_n121,
  count(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 4 preceding and current row) as close_n5,
  count(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as close_n20,
  count(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 59 preceding and current row) as close_n60,
  avg(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 4 preceding and current row) as sma5,
  avg(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as sma20,
  avg(b.valid_close) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 59 preceding and current row) as sma60,
  avg(b.valid_volume) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as vol_mean20,
  stddev_samp(b.valid_volume) over(order by b.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as vol_sd20,
  avg(case when b.valid_close is not null and b.valid_volume is not null then b.valid_close*b.valid_volume end)
   over(order by b.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as dv_mean20,
  max(case when b.valid_bar then b.source_high end)
   over(order by b.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as hi20,
  min(case when b.valid_bar then b.source_low end)
   over(order by b.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as lo20,
  sum(coalesce(b.source_vwap,b.valid_close)*b.valid_volume)
   filter(where b.valid_volume>0 and coalesce(b.source_vwap,b.valid_close)>0)
   over(order by b.interval_start rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cum_pv,
  sum(b.valid_volume) filter(where b.valid_volume>0)
   over(order by b.interval_start rows between unbounded preceding and current row) as cum_vol,
  count(*) filter(where not b.bar_present or not b.valid_bar)
   over(order by b.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as missing20
 from base b window w as (order by b.interval_start)
), returns as (
 select l.*,
  case when l.close_n2=2 and l.valid_close>0 and l.close_lag1>0
   then ln(l.valid_close/l.close_lag1) end as logret1
 from lagged l
), rolled as (
 select r.*,
  count(r.logret1) over(order by r.interval_start rows between 4 preceding and current row) as lr_n5,
  count(r.logret1) over(order by r.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as lr_n20,
  count(r.logret1) over(order by r.interval_start rows between 59 preceding and current row) as lr_n60,
  stddev_samp(r.logret1) over(order by r.interval_start rows between 4 preceding and current row) as rv5,
  stddev_samp(r.logret1) over(order by r.interval_start rows between 19 preceding and current row) as rv20,
  stddev_samp(r.logret1) over(order by r.interval_start rows between 59 preceding and current row) as rv60
 from returns r
)
select x.session_date,'alpaca'::text,p_instrument_id,(select id.provider_symbol from id),x.source_feed,
 x.interval_start,x.interval_start+interval '60 seconds',
 x.interval_start+interval '60 seconds'+make_interval(secs=>p_assumed_publication_seconds),
 x.minute_index,x.minute_index,
 floor(extract(epoch from (x.regular_close-(x.interval_start+interval '60 seconds')))/60)::integer,
 x.source_open,x.source_high,x.source_low,x.source_close,x.source_volume,x.source_trade_count,x.source_vwap,
 x.bar_present,x.valid_bar,
 case when x.valid_close is not null and x.valid_volume is not null then x.valid_close*x.valid_volume end,
 case when x.source_vwap>0 and x.valid_volume is not null then x.source_vwap*x.valid_volume end,
 case when x.close_n2=2 and x.close_lag1>0 then x.valid_close/x.close_lag1-1 end,
 case when x.close_n6=6 and x.close_lag5>0 then x.valid_close/x.close_lag5-1 end,
 case when x.close_n11=11 and x.close_lag10>0 then x.valid_close/x.close_lag10-1 end,
 case when x.close_n21=21 and x.close_lag20>0 then x.valid_close/x.close_lag20-1 end,
 case when x.close_n61=61 and x.close_lag60>0 then x.valid_close/x.close_lag60-1 end,
 case when x.close_n121=121 and x.close_lag120>0 then x.valid_close/x.close_lag120-1 end,
 case when x.lr_n5=5 then x.rv5 end,case when x.lr_n20=20 then x.rv20 end,
 case when x.lr_n60=60 then x.rv60 end,
 case when x.source_open>0 and x.valid_bar then (x.source_high-x.source_low)/x.source_open end,
 case when x.source_open>0 and x.valid_bar then (x.source_close-x.source_open)/x.source_open end,
 case when x.source_open>0 and x.valid_bar then (x.source_high-greatest(x.source_open,x.source_close))/x.source_open end,
 case when x.source_open>0 and x.valid_bar then (least(x.source_open,x.source_close)-x.source_low)/x.source_open end,
 case when x.close_n20=20 and x.lo20>0 then x.hi20/x.lo20-1 end,
 case when x.close_n20=20 then x.vol_mean20 end,
 case when x.close_n20=20 and x.vol_mean20>0 and x.valid_volume is not null then x.valid_volume/x.vol_mean20 end,
 case when x.close_n20=20 and x.vol_sd20>0 and x.valid_volume is not null then (x.valid_volume-x.vol_mean20)/x.vol_sd20 end,
 case when x.close_n20=20 then x.dv_mean20 end,
 case when x.close_n5=5 then x.sma5 end,case when x.close_n20=20 then x.sma20 end,
 case when x.close_n60=60 then x.sma60 end,
 case when x.cum_vol>0 then x.cum_pv/x.cum_vol end,
 case when x.valid_close>0 and x.source_vwap>0 then (x.valid_close/x.source_vwap-1)*10000 end,
 case when x.valid_close>0 and x.cum_vol>0 and x.cum_pv>0 then (x.valid_close/(x.cum_pv/x.cum_vol)-1)*10000 end,
 case when x.valid_close>0 and x.close_n20=20 and x.sma20>0 then (x.valid_close/x.sma20-1)*10000 end,
 case when x.close_n20=20 and x.sma5>0 and x.sma20>0 then (x.sma5/x.sma20-1)*10000 end,
 x.missing20::integer,case when x.minute_index>=19 then (20-x.missing20)::double precision/20 end,
 x.micro_present,x.micro_trades,x.micro_quotes,x.micro_spread,
 case when x.last_bid_price>0 and x.last_ask_price>0 and x.last_bid_price+x.last_ask_price>0
  then (x.last_ask_price-x.last_bid_price)/((x.last_ask_price+x.last_bid_price)/2)*10000 end,
 case when coalesce(x.buy_volume,0)+coalesce(x.sell_volume,0)>0
  then (coalesce(x.buy_volume,0)-coalesce(x.sell_volume,0))/(coalesce(x.buy_volume,0)+coalesce(x.sell_volume,0)) end,
 case when coalesce(x.last_bid_size,0)+coalesce(x.last_ask_size,0)>0
  then (coalesce(x.last_bid_size,0)-coalesce(x.last_ask_size,0))/(coalesce(x.last_bid_size,0)+coalesce(x.last_ask_size,0)) end,
 case when x.last_trade_price>0 and x.last_bid_price>0 and x.last_ask_price>0
  and x.last_bid_price+x.last_ask_price>0
  then (x.last_trade_price/((x.last_bid_price+x.last_ask_price)/2)-1)*10000 end,
 jsonb_build_object(
  'source_row_present',x.bar_present,'ohlc_valid',x.valid_bar,'volume_valid',x.valid_volume is not null,
  'exact_clock_grid',true,'missing_bars_20m',x.missing20,'microstructure_available',x.micro_present,
  'identity_mapping_quality',(select id.mapping_quality from id),
  'corporate_action_adjustment_status','UNVERIFIED','outcome_independent',true)
from rolled x
where p_assumed_publication_seconds between 0 and 60
order by x.interval_start
$function$

p_decision_ts timestamp with time zone, p_allow_retrospective_acquired_version boolean
